<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using a valid SMILES for the flavanone product. The SMILES "O=C1C(C2=ccccc2)C3CC(O)C4=ccccc34" represents a flavanone. I will specify the functional groups broken (ketones, aromatic hydroxyls) and formed (ether oxygens) as described.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=ccccc2)C3CC(O)C4=ccccc34",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
